title: Verify extracted fields against the text
description: Verify each field a cheaper extractor returned: does the text state this exact value as that field

ok.instructions: Extracted field: {{name}} = '{{value}}'. Does the text contain this exact string as the {{name}}?

criteria.false: the text does not state this {{name}}

combine: accept if ok >= accept_at; reject if ok <= reject_at; review otherwise
limitations: one request per field (the text prefix is cached)
the decision is the most severe over the fields (reject > review > accept); read items for each field
notes: # deviation: spec 5.11: fields is an array of {name, value} and each field is its own request with the fixed question id `ok` (the engine cannot name a question after an input), so the decision is the worst over the fields and items carry the per-field decisions; the field-specific poles are 'the text states this <name>'
